verdict.rationale: Cal.com's agent docs explicitly point to an official Cal.com CLI and recommend it over direct API calls for agents that can run commands on a machine. That is a direct, AI-native-oriented claim of the capability. It is a single sentence, though, with no detail on installation, commands, auth or coverage. Missing for 10: CLI installation and command reference docs, which operations the CLI covers (bookings, event types, schedules), how it authenticates, and independent or hands-on confirmation that it works.
